tensor_square.scope: The pointwise square identity only; not the integrated transport estimate.

gaussian_operator.scope: Gaussian polynomial model only; no assertion of general range density.

weighted_projection.scope: Finite numerical examples, not a proof that this iteration always converges.

support_incidence.scope: Defect and incidence identities; the dimension conclusion uses the written strict-convexity argument.

covering_constants.scope: Constants in covering estimates, not a sampling of the infinite metric space.

jacobian_compatibility.scope: Coefficient identity and normal forms; not the global entropy inequality.

cone_constants.scope: Cone and simplex constants only; the entropy bound remains a separate input.

limitation: Finite checks and examples do not certify the source theorems or mathematical novelty.
